statements.text: River water is a natural resource because nature provides it and it helps meet needs.
The plastic bottle is a natural resource because it is useful for carrying water.
Cotton fibre is not a natural resource because it will later be made into cloth.

stem: Bilal sorts three things: river water collected for drinking, a plastic bottle made in a factory, and cotton fibre from plants used to make cloth.

teacher.key_rationale: A natural resource is provided by nature and helps meet needs. River water and plant cotton qualify; a factory plastic bottle does not, and later use as cloth does not disqualify cotton.
